title: Combo system in my turn-based wizard duel
author: Dacrikka
selftext:
Hi! I’m a creative director, not a programmer. Spellz is a turn-based wizard duel that runs in the browser as a single HTML file. I designed it; Claude Code wrote the code.

The video shows the combo layer. The Crucible gives you 63 spells (21 ingredients × 3 talismans), and I wanted the order in which you cast them to matter, not only their damage. So there are three interactions between spells:

* Shatter: hit a frozen target and you deal +50% damage, then the ice breaks
* Toxic Detonation: fire on a poisoned target makes the poison explode for double its remaining value
* Conduction: lightning on a target in or next to water arcs to adjacent enemies for 60% damage

The Crucible preview tells you which combos a spell enables, so you can plan your grimoire before the duel.

Some things that might be useful to this sub:

* Writing the rules was easy for the AI. Judging them was not. It implemented each combo in minutes, but it couldn’t tell me if a combo was fun or broken. That still took playtesting.
* I don’t record trailers by hand anymore. Claude Code wrote a script that runs the game in headless Chrome, clicks on real tiles, casts real spells and captures the frames. Game time is slowed 6x during capture, so the video stays smooth.
* The script also checks itself. It hooks the function that shows “SHATTER”, “DETONATION” and “CONDUCTION” on screen, so I know each combo really fired in the footage and wasn’t just staged.
* Making videos is a free QA pass. While recording the Crucible, I found that long English ingredient names were overlapping their descriptions. I hadn’t noticed it in 13 versions.
* Art is generated locally in ComfyUI (Krea2 + a painterly LoRA), then picked and fixed by hand with Krtia and Photoshop. Music is Suno.

It’s free to play here: [https://dacrikka.itch.io/spellz](https://dacrikka.itch.io/spellz)  
(there is also a Kids version https://dacrikka.itch.io/spellz-kids-edition)
